<!--
Purpose: Handle every data issue listed in answer_key/ground_truth.md and build one
         student-year analysis panel with covariates, outcomes, and treatment timing.
Reads:   data_raw/
Writes:  answer_key/data_clean/1000_student_year.rds
Packages: here, tidyverse, knitr
-->

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
set.seed(20261016)
raw_dir   <- here::here("data_raw")
clean_dir <- here::here("answer_key", "data_clean")
dir.create(clean_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Study definitions

The intervention (CNI) starts in **2019**. It targets ZIP **63106** and five schools. CNI status is not in the raw files, so it is hard-coded here, as in the original study.

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
POLICY_YEAR <- 2019
CNI_ZIP     <- "63106"
CNI_SCHOOLS <- c("900100-1410", "900100-1560", "900100-1600", "900100-1930", "900200-1150")

# St. Louis City and County ZIP codes present in the data (study area)
STL_CITY_ZIPS   <- c(63101, 63102, 63103, 63104, 63106, 63107, 63108, 63109, 63110,
                     63111, 63112, 63113, 63115, 63116, 63118, 63139, 63147)
STL_COUNTY_ZIPS <- c(63011, 63017, 63021, 63031, 63033, 63034, 63105, 63114, 63117,
                     63119, 63121, 63122, 63123, 63124, 63125, 63126, 63127, 63128,
                     63129, 63130, 63131, 63132, 63133, 63134, 63135, 63136, 63138,
                     63141, 63144, 63146)
STL_ZIPS <- as.character(c(STL_CITY_ZIPS, STL_COUNTY_ZIPS))
```

## Read raw files

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
read_raw <- function(file, ...) {
  readr::read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, file), show_col_types = FALSE, ...)
}
core   <- read_raw("dese_student_core.csv", col_types = cols(zipcode = col_character()))
test   <- read_raw("dese_student_test.csv")
enroll <- read_raw("dese_student_enroll.csv")
disc   <- read_raw("dese_student_discipline.csv")
```

## Core file: one record per student-year in the study area

Data issues 1–4: mid-year movers have two records (keep the later `seq`), years before 2014 are dropped, ZIP+4 codes are cut to five digits, and blank or out-of-area ZIPs are dropped.

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
log_step <- function(log, step, data) {
  bind_rows(log, tibble(step = step, rows = nrow(data), students = n_distinct(data$research_id)))
}
clean_log <- log_step(tibble(), "Raw core records", core)

core1 <- core %>% filter(currentschoolyear >= 2014)
clean_log <- log_step(clean_log, "Drop years before 2014", core1)

core2 <- core1 %>%
  group_by(research_id, currentschoolyear) %>%
  slice_max(seq, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
clean_log <- log_step(clean_log, "Keep latest record (highest seq) per student-year", core2)

core3 <- core2 %>%
  mutate(zip = str_sub(str_trim(zipcode), 1, 5),
         zip = na_if(zip, "")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(zip))
clean_log <- log_step(clean_log, "Drop blank ZIP codes (ZIP+4 cut to 5 digits)", core3)

core4 <- core3 %>% filter(zip %in% STL_ZIPS)
clean_log <- log_step(clean_log, "Keep St. Louis City/County ZIPs only", core4)
```

## Recode covariates and flag treatment exposure

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
students <- core4 %>%
  transmute(
    research_id,
    year     = currentschoolyear,
    grade    = studentgradelevel,
    zip,
    school   = paste(reportingdistrictcode, reportingschoolcode, sep = "-"),
    city     = zip %in% as.character(STL_CITY_ZIPS),
    female   = gender == 1,
    black    = raceethnicity == 1,
    hispanic = raceethnicity == 3,
    white    = raceethnicity == 2,
    frl      = lunchstatus %in% c(1, 2),
    ell      = lepell == 1,
    iep      = iepdisability > 0,
    in_cni_school = school %in% CNI_SCHOOLS,
    in_cni_zip    = zip == CNI_ZIP
  )
```

## Treatment cohorts

A student's cohort is the **first year from 2019 on** in which they are observed in a CNI school (`g_school`) or living in ZIP 63106 (`g_zip`). Students never exposed get `0`, the value `did::att_gt()` expects for never-treated units. Treatment is treated as absorbing: once in a cohort, a student stays in it even after moving away (an intent-to-treat definition).

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
first_exposure <- function(exposed, year) {
  y <- year[exposed & year >= POLICY_YEAR]
  if (length(y) == 0) 0 else min(y)
}

students <- students %>%
  group_by(research_id) %>%
  mutate(g_school = first_exposure(in_cni_school, year),
         g_zip    = first_exposure(in_cni_zip, year)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## MAP test scores

Data issues 5–6: scores carrying a +2000 code are corrected (`2195` → `195`). There are no tests in 2020, and some students miss one subject; those stay `NA`.

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
map <- test %>%
  mutate(across(c(map_score1, map_score2), ~ if_else(.x >= 2000, .x - 2000, .x))) %>%
  transmute(research_id, year = currentschoolyear, map_ela = map_score1, map_math = map_score2)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(map[c("research_id", "year")]))
```

## Attendance and discipline (placebo outcomes)

Data issue 8: mid-year movers have two enrollment rows, collapsed to one attendance rate weighted by days enrolled. Data issue 7: discipline is one row per incident; it is summed to days per student-year. Missing lengths count as zero days, but the incident is still counted. Students with no discipline record had no removals.

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
attendance <- enroll %>%
  group_by(research_id, year = currentschoolyear) %>%
  summarise(days_enrolled = sum(daysenrolled),
            attend_rate   = weighted.mean(attendancerate, daysenrolled),
            .groups = "drop")

discipline <- disc %>%
  group_by(research_id, year = currentschoolyear) %>%
  summarise(n_removals   = n(),
            susp_days    = sum(lengthremoved[disciplineremoval %in% c(1, 2)], na.rm = TRUE),  # ISS + OSS
            removal_days = sum(lengthremoved, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
```

## Merge into the student-year panel

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
panel <- students %>%
  left_join(map,        by = c("research_id", "year")) %>%
  left_join(attendance, by = c("research_id", "year")) %>%
  left_join(discipline, by = c("research_id", "year")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(n_removals, susp_days, removal_days), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  arrange(research_id, year)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(panel[c("research_id", "year")]))
clean_log <- log_step(clean_log, "Final student-year panel", panel)
```

## Cleaning log

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
kable(clean_log, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## Treatment cohorts in the panel

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
panel %>%
  distinct(research_id, g_school, g_zip) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(g_school, g_zip), names_to = "treatment", values_to = "cohort") %>%
  mutate(cohort = if_else(cohort == 0, "never treated", as.character(cohort))) %>%
  count(treatment, cohort, name = "students") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = students) %>%
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## Save the analysis file

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
write_rds(panel, file.path(clean_dir, "1000_student_year.rds"))
```
